name: Send to Tuyo User

steps.title: Home screen (with balance)
steps.description: Home dashboard with $1.00 Total balance. EARN ($0.00) and CASH ($1.00) sections. Recent transactions visible.

steps.title: Add Recipient
steps.description: Send screen with three recipient options: Find on Tuyo (BEST), Wallet Address, Bank Account.

steps.title: Tuyo user found
steps.description: Search input showing 'joe'. Result: @joe with verified checkmark and avatar. User can tap to select as recipient.
steps.changes: Bottom sheet with search input and matching result.

steps.title: Tuyo user not found
steps.description: Search input showing 'joep'. No results returned — empty state below the search field.
steps.changes: Search results cleared, no match found.

notes: Steps 3 and 4 show the found/not-found states of the same search screen.
